unsupported: The store sits beside Lodge's operating foundries on the edge of the Cumberland Plateau, about 30 minutes west of Chattanooga.
The flagship store operates seven days a week and also offers custom-engraved skillets through its Custom Shop.
The store serves home cooks, campers, and outdoor enthusiasts who visit the showroom or shop online.

The company emphasizes its direct connection to the foundry as a differentiator, allowing shoppers to purchase factory seconds at a discount and to see new designs such as the annual Holiday Mini Skillet shortly after they are cast.
The location also functions as a gateway to the adjacent Lodge Museum, reinforcing the brand's heritage narrative.
